candidates.statement: Section II of the guidance provides general information on combination products and how FDA regulates them. Section III provides a summary of the combination product PMSR final rule and an overview of which entities are subject to the final rule and what safety reporting requirements apply to them. Section IV provides more detailed discussion of specific combination product PMSR report types. Section V provides guidance on where, how, and when to submit PMSR reports to FDA. Section VI provides hypothetical scenarios that illustrate certain ways to comply with certain combination product PMSR requirements. While this guidance focuses on the combination product PMSR final rule, it also addresses associated topics including postmarketing safety reporting requirements applicable to entities not covered by the rule (see Appendix 3).
